title: slingbag: point cloud-based iterative algorithm for large-scale 3d photoacoustic imaging
core_idea: Model the 3D photoacoustic scene as a point cloud of Gaussian-distributed spherical sources and perform iterative reconstruction by continuously optimizing each source's parameters (peak intensity/initial pressure, standard deviation/size, mean/position) while adaptively destroying, splitting, and duplicating sources along gradient directions to drastically reduce memory and computing demands for large-scale 3D imaging with sparsely distributed sensors.
tldr: Proposes SlingBag, a point-cloud iterative reconstruction that represents the scene as adaptive Gaussian spherical sources whose parameters and numbers are optimized to reduce memory and computation for large-scale 3D photoacoustic imaging with sparse sensors.
